values: Edit Proposed Description and Notes. Leave Proposed Description blank when no wording change is needed. Status updates automatically.
Chooses Vanilla or Karla for RALLE interface body text and controls. Fox screen headers always use Karla.
Allows RALLE's local chat options to operate in singleplayer or on any server.
Opens the HUD layout editor for moving, resizing, or restoring the single chat box.
Hides Minecraft's scrollbar while chat is open. Mouse-wheel scrolling still works.
Enables RALLE's selected top-down or bottom-up message direction.
Chooses whether new messages appear from the bottom or the top.
Enables RALLE's selected left or right text alignment.
Chooses whether chat text is aligned to the left or right edge.
Enables RALLE's selected chat text shadow style.
Chooses no shadow, Minecraft's vanilla shadow, an opaque offset shadow, or a soft shadow wrapped around the text.
Collapses identical messages received within 45 seconds and displays a repetition count.
Collapses consecutive blank chat lines into one line.
While chat is open, hold either Ctrl key and left-drag across messages to prepare a transparent chat image. Ctrl+C or double-click copies it.
Animates screenshot selection height changes over 120 milliseconds instead of snapping immediately.
Plays instrument feedback as the selected message count changes and after a chat image is copied successfully.
Allows RALLE to authenticate and connect to the Kingdom Foxes Raid LFG service after joining Wynncraft.
Shows a compact HUD card when a new party becomes available to join.
Shows a compact HUD card when a locked or unavailable party becomes joinable again.
Keeps your current party on the HUD when it was created or joined outside the Raid LFG screen. Close the card to dismiss it.
After you create or join a party through Raid LFG, closes the screen and keeps that party on the HUD until you leave, disband, or close the card.
Plays sound feedback for Raid LFG notifications and confirmed party membership changes.
Opens the HUD editor with the fixed-size Raid LFG notification anchor selected.
Opens Raid LFG with a configurable key. It is unbound by default; /ralle lfg is always available as a fallback.
Starts the three-second Join countdown for the newest visible joinable notification card.
Dismisses the newest visible Raid LFG notification without cancelling or leaving anything.
Leaves your current party, or arms a five-second second-press confirmation when you are host.
Invites every synchronized non-host member to the Wynncraft party when your Raid LFG lobby is full.
Pings the current party when you are its host and Ping is off cooldown.
Toggles joining for the current party after a one-second coalescing delay when you are its host.
Hold this key and release top-row 1–6 to create Dailies, NOTG, NOL, TCC, TNA, or TWP.
Hold this key and release top-row 2–4 to kick that synchronized roster slot.
